text: DSH Maestro Govard 将独立 Govard CLI 工具接入 DSH Web。它注册环境管理、工作区文件、代码审计和部署检查工具。用户可启动或关闭项目环境，在工作区读写文本文件，获取结构化 Magento lint 结果，查看部署计划或预检目标。适合使用 Govard 管理项目和发布流程的开发者。需另行安装 Govard CLI 并确保可调用。

DSH Maestro Govard connects Govard CLI tools to DSH Web. Agents can manage environments, access workspace files, inspect Magento lint results and deployment plans, and run deployment preflight checks. It supports developers using Govard projects. Install Govard CLI separately.
想让 DSH agent 在当前工作区启动和关闭 Govard 开发环境。
需要在 DSH 对话里读取或写入项目中的文本文件。

Can DSH check SSH connectivity and permissions for a Govard deployment target?
DSH Maestro Govard 的功能「Govard 环境管理」：在 DSH 工具调用中初始化并启动当前项目环境，也可关闭环境并清理关联卷。调用 govard_env_up 或 govard_env_down，无需额外输入。
DSH Maestro Govard 的功能「工作区文件读写」：提供 maestro_read_file 与 maestro_write_file，按配置根目录或当前 agent 会话工作区定位文本文件；写入时会创建父目录。
DSH Maestro Govard 的功能「Govard 代码审计」：调用 govard_audit_lint 运行 lint 或 integrity 检查，并返回结构化发现。可指定工作区、检查范围、基线和 PHP 版本。
DSH Maestro Govard 的功能「部署计划」：输入 Govard remote 和构建模式，返回机器可读的部署步骤、执行位置及跳过原因；该操作读取项目配置，不连接部署目标。
DSH Maestro Govard 的功能「部署预检」：针对指定 remote 检查连接、权限、目录布局和发布策略，并返回 Govard CLI 输出；工具使用项目路径、构建模式和制品目录作为输入。
DSH Maestro Govard 依赖独立安装的 govard CLI，包本身不包含 Go 引擎；环境和审计工具会启动该命令，使用前需保证它可调用。
DSH Maestro Govard 的部署预检会通过 SSH 连接目标，并在目标创建后清理临时探测目录；部署计划本身不连接目标。
想让 DSH 帮我在 Govard 项目里检查代码质量。
DSH 能否帮忙在工作区里查看和修改文本文件？

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-govard README · @ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-govard：Thin DeepSeek Harness bridge for [Govard](https://github.com/ddtcorex/govard) — exposes Govard workspace/project
tooling to DSH sessions as registered tools. The Govard engine itself is a separate Go
codebase and binary; this package only bridges, it does not embed Go code.

Part of the Maestro Harness suite (`dsh-maestro-*`). Cordis patch row id: `dsh-maestro-govard`
(short alias `maestro-govard` in the meta bundle).

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-govard README · What it provides：- Tool registrations that shell out to the `govard` binary (environment up/down, commands in
  container, DB dumps/imports, debug configuration) with schemastery-typed parameters.
- Non-mutating deploy inspection: `govard_deploy_plan` (the resolved pipeline for a remote as its
  machine-readable `kind: "plan"` document, no connection needed) and `govard_deploy_check`
  (the preflight against a target; it leaves nothing behind there). The mutating deploy commands stay in the terminal. Both take
  `projectPath`, because the host process's own directory is rarely the project a session is
  working in — the tools fall back to the configured root, then the session workspace.
- Workspace path resolution consistent with the rest of the Maestro suite.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-govard README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-govard
```

The Go binary is built separately in the `govard` repository (`make build`); this bridge
expects it available on PATH or at its configured location.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-govard README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm verify   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm test     # vitest run
pnpm build    # tsc -> lib/

Runtime features must be validated live against a real Govard-managed project before handoff
— see AGENTS.md.
